problems: No earlier dossiers existed for these six states; all six are written and validate (0 errors, 0 warnings, --resolve clean).

catalan-company runs 1311-1390 (page) against Cliopatria's 1314-1362; Cliopatria's Crown of Aragon row (1363-1394) covers the same Greek bbox, so the crown-of-aragon/kingdom-of-sicily dossiers should subtract the Catalan duchies and carry the 1312 Sicilian overlordship.
duchy-of-the-archipelago: Cliopatria's 1305-1313 shape is Andros only (664.5 km2) and was marked wrong; the dossier is extended to 1207-1579 on one page; Cliopatria has no row for 1314-1579.

thessaly: 3 pages against a 1-2 budget (Medieval Thessaly opened to settle the 1268 start, the capital and 1318-1332); start 1268 differs from the Thessaly page (1271) and Cliopatria (1272); end kept at 1332 although the Thessaly page says independence ended in 1318.

empire-of-thessalonica: start 1230 (split recorded by despotate-of-epirus), not Cliopatria's 1236; the despotate-of-epirus dossier's 1241 Thessaly gain names empire-of-thessalonica as counterpart whereas the pages have Manuel Komnenos Doukas holding Thessaly 1239-1241.

commune-of-the-zealots is typed rebel and keeps Cliopatria's wikipedia value 'Thessaloniki' (the state's article is 'Zealots of Thessalonica'); the byzantine-empire dossier has no 1342/1350 Thessalonica events.
principality-of-theodoro ends December 1475 (Cliopatria 1474); the Genoa dossier (eu-13) should subtract the coastal strip Theodoro held from the 1420s.
Several regions are lon/lat discs because the gazetteer lacks the island or town names; the grid is 15 km, so the discs are approximate.
